# People Atlas 0.11.0 — Alpha

> [!WARNING]
> People Atlas 0.11.0 is an alpha version of the plugin. Its fundamental
> behavior is subject to change in future releases.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Compatibility: People Atlas 0.11.0 only supports Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer.
> Obsidian 1.12.x and older are not supported.**

0.11.0 adds a multilingual user interface (English and Dutch) and locale-aware
formatting for the visible UI.

> [!NOTE]
> Publishing People Atlas in the Community Plugins directory remains a separate
> step from this GitHub prerelease.

## Changes

- **Multilingual UI:** user-facing notices, validations and labels now follow
  the language Obsidian runs in, with full **English** and **Dutch
  (Nederlands)** copy backed by a typed message catalog.
- **Locale-aware formatting:** date, number and plural forms render according
  to the active locale at the UI boundary, while the canonical values stored in
  your vault are never altered.
- The production bundle limit was raised to keep the larger, localized release
  build within a verified 500,000-byte ceiling; the shipped `main.js` is
  ~417 KB and well inside that limit.

## Breaking change / upgrade note

People Atlas 0.11.0 continues the fresh-vault-only boundary for the
presentation-first dossier layout. It does not migrate older folder layouts or
provide a backward-compatibility path for them.

## Assets

Install or update the plugin with the attached `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and
`styles.css`.
